enabledHint.message: When you switch tab or minimise

onBlurHint.message: Works after a recent click on the page

forceAllowHint.message: Allow PiP where the site disables it

privacy.message: No data collected: everything stays on your device.

noVideo.message: No video found in this tab

welcomeIntro.message: PIPV. automatically opens the playing video in a floating window that stays on top of all others. Hover over it to show the controls. Complete these steps once:

step1.message: Allow “Automatic picture-in-picture” in site settings (Chrome, Brave, Edge).

step2.message: If the option is missing (older Chrome or Brave), enable this flag and restart the browser:

step3.message: Play a video, then switch tab or minimise the browser: the video appears in PiP. The first time the browser may ask you to keep auto PiP: choose “Allow”.

step4.message: Manual alternative: click the PIPV. icon or press Alt+P (customisable in chrome://extensions/shortcuts).
